The '''Borleias outpost''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] military base established on [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] to aid [[Borleias Operations]] after the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] while the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was contested.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction" />
